nodes.label: Design Tokens (:root)
nodes.rationale: The single source of truth for every colour, space, and motion value, read by JS via getComputedStyle. Neutrals authored in OKLCH and stored as resolved sRGB hex (since THREE.Color cannot parse oklch); no #000/#fff anywhere. Clinical palette: paper #ffffff, panel #f5f5f5.

nodes.label: Guided Stepper Chrome (Rail + Card)
nodes.rationale: A vertical numbered step rail (progress spine, is-complete/is-current/is-upcoming) beside the step card (the tutor panel); upcoming steps render disabled and out of tab order so the rail is a map you can only walk back along, never skip ahead.

nodes.label: Sim Viewport (WebGL + CSS2D)
nodes.rationale: The WebGL canvas plus the CSS2D label overlay (vertex labels, plane labels, reference-line labels, view-name captions), positioned on the left with the wizard on the right; drag-to-orbit disables text selection and touch scrolling.

nodes.label: Quick-View Camera Chips
nodes.rationale: A segmented pill group (Top/Front/Side) in the top-left .vp-cluster; the latched view fills solid accent, and clicking it again returns to perspective orbit.

nodes.label: Connector-Line Toggle
nodes.rationale: A pill toggle beneath the quick-view group that fills solid accent when on (declutter of connector/projector lines); the hidden checkbox makes the chip itself the on/off affordance, reflected via :has().

nodes.label: Orbit-Lock Cue (qv-lock-cue)
nodes.rationale: A drag on a rotate-locked ortho view nudges the latched chip with a shake+ring animation ('disengage this view to orbit'); reduced motion keeps the ring but drops the shake.

nodes.label: Boot Watchdog / Sim Fallback
nodes.rationale: A classic-script watchdog arming a self-healing fallback if the pinned Three.js CDN module (the sim's only runtime network dependency) fails to load or WebGL is unavailable; main.js clears it on successful boot so a merely-slow load self-heals. The struggling learner reads a calm explanation, not a void.

nodes.label: Three.js CDN Import Map
nodes.rationale: Three.js loaded as CDN ES modules only, pinned to 0.160.0, with no build step/bundler/npm — the exact import-map contract required by the platform.

nodes.label: Mobile Notice
nodes.rationale: A dismissible 'Best experienced on desktop' banner at <768px (#mobile-notice, role=status) that never blocks the sim — the platform contract advisory.

nodes.label: Success Toast
nodes.rationale: A calm win confirmation for 'Complete & next problem' — success green plus a check glyph (two-cue rule), a transient floating surface that earns the overlay shadow (Flat-Ink exception), never gamified fanfare.

nodes.label: Two-State Reset Confirm
nodes.rationale: The ghost Reset arms into a quiet 'Reset everything? · Yes / Cancel' on the same spot so a stray click can't wipe the drawing; only 'Yes' calls simAPI.reset() (single reset path).

nodes.label: Slider + Numeric Field Control
nodes.rationale: A borderless 14px accent dot thumb on a thin 3px pill track with a 44px transparent hit-area; paired with a right-aligned tabular-nums numeric field, following the thin-visual / full-hit pattern.

nodes.label: First-Angle Projection Symbol
nodes.rationale: A screen-space HTML/SVG annotation pinned bottom-right, hidden until the drawing flattens (Step 5) then faded in; a pure overlay (not a scene object) so it stays put during orbit.

nodes.label: Domain Colours (HP/VP/PP Encoding)
nodes.rationale: Viewport-only projection encodings: HP teal SOLID (#007f7c), VP amber DASHED (#bc5d1e), PP violet (#7a5ea6) — a CVD-safe pair held off the chrome blue, each carrying a non-colour cue (Two-Cue Rule) and meeting AA on paper.

nodes.label: Onboarding Hints (Orbit + Spotlight)
nodes.rationale: A one-time dismissible orbit-discovery chip (auto-dismissed on first drag) plus contextual spotlight hints with a leading colour dot tying the hint to its linework (teal HP / amber VP / ink connectors), played one at a time so they never stack.

nodes.label: Wizard Hide/Show Toggle
nodes.rationale: A floating 44px control pinned to the viewport's top-right that collapses the step panel for a larger 3D view (body.wizard-collapsed) and brings it back; the chevron flips when collapsed and the viewport reflows to full width via flex.
